description: Check that an OpenLint/Spectral ruleset is valid BEFORE running or storing it: invalid JSONPath, unknown functions, undefined aliases, and anything the engine rejects. Catalog metadata (title, prompt, x-*) is set aside and reported. Run this on every ruleset you write.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on the task you are doing. Never used to answer or rank; read only if a result is reported wrong.

ruleset.description: A Spectral ruleset to run instead of the catalog default. Score against rules you never adopted means little — pass your own.

name: validate_ruleset
